daily_summary.es: Apple domina la jornada con filtraciones del HomePad y del iPhone Duo junto al análisis del teardown del iPhone 18 Pro y las quejas sobre la nueva Siri, mientras en IA destacan un nuevo marco de JetBrains para herramientas de desarrollo y un informe sobre el creciente e-waste generado por la infraestructura de IA.
daily_summary.en: Apple dominates the day with leaks about the HomePad and iPhone Duo alongside the iPhone 18 Pro teardown and Siri complaints, while in AI a new JetBrains framework for dev tools and a report on rising AI infrastructure e-waste stand out.

apple.es: Apple concentra varias filtraciones y análisis: un nuevo dispositivo con pantalla inteligente llamado HomePad se presentaría el próximo mes como centro de control del hogar, el iPhone Duo plegable busca reactivar las ventas según IDC (aunque un Apple Pencil más corto pensado para él fue descartado por problemas técnicos), el teardown de iFixit revela mejoras de batería y un problema de agrietamiento en el marco de pantalla del iPhone 18 Pro, y usuarios reportan frustraciones con la nueva Siri en beta.
apple.en: Apple sees several leaks and reviews converge: a new smart-screen device called HomePad is expected to be unveiled next month as a home control hub, the foldable iPhone Duo aims to reinvigorate sales per IDC (though a shorter Apple Pencil meant for it was scrapped over technical issues), iFixit's teardown reveals battery gains and a screen-frame cracking issue on the iPhone 18 Pro, and users report frustrations with the new beta Siri.

title.es: Se filtra el HomePad, la nueva pantalla inteligente de Apple
title.en: Apple's new HomePad smart screen leaks

body.es: Según se informa, Apple está probando internamente un dispositivo con nombre en clave J940, conocido como 'HomePad', una pantalla inteligente que actuaría como centro de control del hogar integrando accesorios inteligentes, telefonillo y apps clásicas. Se espera que se presente el próximo mes como parte de los lanzamientos de otoño, con un diseño casi cuadrado que podría usarse sobre soporte o montado en la pared.
body.en: Apple is reportedly testing internally a device codenamed J940, known as the 'HomePad,' a smart screen meant to serve as a home control hub integrating smart accessories, an intercom and classic apps. It is expected to be unveiled next month as part of Apple's autumn launches, with a nearly square design usable on a stand or mounted on a wall.

evidence.claim: Apple is developing a first-of-its-kind smart screen device named 'HomePad'.
The HomePad will serve as a central control hub for home devices, integrating smart accessories, intercoms, and classic apps.
The HomePad is expected to be unveiled in the upcoming month as part of Apple's autumn product launches.
The HomePad will feature a nearly square screen and can be used in two ways: either on a stand or mounted on the wall.

title.es: El iPhone Duo plegable, la apuesta de Apple para reactivar las ventas
title.en: Foldable iPhone Duo is Apple's bet to reinvigorate sales

body.es: IDC prevé que Apple venda 10 millones de unidades del iPhone Duo en sus primeros 12 meses, apostando por la 'novedad' para atraer a clientes dispuestos a pagar precios altos, en un contexto donde los ingresos por iPhone se han mantenido casi planos entre 2022 y 2025. Los ingresos globales por plegables crecieron un 16% en 2025, frente a un 7% de los no plegables, según IDC.
body.en: IDC forecasts Apple will sell 10 million units of the iPhone Duo in its first 12 months, betting on 'novelty' to attract high-end customers, amid iPhone revenue that has stayed nearly flat from 2022 to 2025. Global foldable smartphone revenue grew 16% year-over-year in 2025, versus 7% growth for non-foldables, per IDC.

evidence.claim: The launch of the iPhone Duo is a play to reinvigorate iPhone sales by offering something new to consumers.
IDC analysts forecast that Apple will be selling 10 million units in the first 12 months after launch.
The iPhone Duo will introduce 'novelty' and help drive high-end customers willing to pay the highest prices for whatever Apple brings out.
Revenue from iPhones hasn't really changed much over the last few years.
Global revenue from foldable smartphones rose 16% year-over-year in 2025, versus a 7% growth for non-foldables.

title.es: El teardown de iFixit revela mejoras y un problema del iPhone 18 Pro
title.en: iFixit teardown reveals iPhone 18 Pro improvements and a flaw

body.es: iFixit publicó el desmontaje del iPhone 18 Pro y Pro Max, mostrando que la batería del Pro Max crece un 9.4% hasta 5,567 mAh y la del Pro un 0.8% hasta 4,288 mAh, además de una cámara de vapor más grande para refrigeración. Sin embargo, en tres de los cuatro modelos abiertos el marco de plástico de la pantalla se agrietó o se desprendió, un problema nuevo que no existía en modelos anteriores.
body.en: iFixit published a teardown of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, showing the Pro Max battery grows 9.4% to 5,567 mAh and the Pro's grows 0.8% to 4,288 mAh, plus a larger vapor chamber for cooling. However, in three of the four units opened, the screen's plastic frame cracked or broke away, a new issue not seen in previous models.

evidence.claim: iFixit published a teardown of the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.
The battery capacity for the iPhone 18 Pro eSIM-only model is 4,288 mAh.
The battery capacity for the iPhone 18 Pro Max eSIM-only model is 5,567 mAh.
The new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models have a larger vapor chamber for cooling.
The screen's plastic frame cracked or broke away on three of the four iPhone 18 Pro models iFixit opened.

title.es: La nueva Siri con IA frustra a algunos usuarios de iPhone y Apple Watch
title.en: New AI Siri frustrates some iPhone and Apple Watch users

body.es: La nueva Siri se está desplegando gradualmente mediante lista de espera y está etiquetada como 'beta', lo que indica que Apple aún tiene trabajo pendiente. Puede buscar en mensajes y notas para responder consultas personales y actuar según lo que aparece en pantalla, pero los usuarios reportan varias frustraciones con su funcionamiento actual.
body.en: The new Siri is rolling out gradually via a waitlist and is labeled 'beta,' indicating Apple still has work to do. It can search messages and notes to answer personal queries and take action based on onscreen content, but users report several frustrations with its current behavior.

evidence.claim: The new Siri, Siri AI, is rolling out gradually to users via a waitlist.
The new Siri can search through messages and notes for personal context queries.
The new Siri can take action based on what is on the screen with onscreen awareness.
The new Siri is labeled as a beta, indicating that Apple still has work to do in follow-up releases.

title.es: Informe advierte de una avalancha de chatarra electrónica por la IA
title.en: Report warns of an AI-driven e-waste surge

body.es: Un informe estima que la infraestructura de IA podría generar entre 395 y 617 millones de toneladas de residuos electrónicos entre 2025 y 2050, suficiente para llenar entre 15 y 23 millones de contenedores, una fila equivalente a rodear la Tierra seis veces. El reporte argumenta que las estimaciones previas se centraban solo en servidores y GPUs, que representan apenas el 13% del peso del equipo de un centro de datos, y señala que ningún gobierno o gran proveedor ha publicado un plan para gestionar este problema.
body.en: A report estimates AI infrastructure could generate between 395 million and 617 million tonnes of e-waste from 2025 to 2050, enough to fill 15 to 23 million shipping containers—a line circling Earth roughly six times. The report argues prior estimates focused only on servers and GPUs, which make up just 13% of a datacenter's equipment by weight, and notes no hyperscaler or government has published a plan to handle the problem.

evidence.claim: AI infrastructure could generate enough electronic waste by 2050 to fill a line of shipping containers stretching around Earth six times.
The report estimates that AI infrastructure will generate between 395 million and 617 million tonnes of e-waste from 2025 to 2050.
Existing estimates focused chiefly on servers and accelerators such as GPUs, which account for just 13 percent of a datacenter's equipment by weight.
The report identifies five equipment categories comprising networking, power distribution, backup power systems, servers plus accelerators, and cooling.
No hyperscaler, government, or international body has published a plan for handling AI-driven e-waste on the scale projected.

title.es: JetBrains presenta AIDEs, un marco para herramientas de desarrollo con IA
title.en: JetBrains unveils AIDEs, a framework for AI development tools

body.es: Tras casi dos años de investigación de producto y mercado en IA, JetBrains presentó el marco AIDEs como una especie de 'teoría de todo' para entender las herramientas de desarrollo con IA, en un momento en que nuevos modelos y prácticas aparecen casi a diario. El marco busca dar orden conceptual a un panorama que cambia constantemente.
body.en: After nearly two years of AI product and market research, JetBrains introduced the AIDEs framework as a kind of 'theory of everything' for understanding AI development tools, at a time when new models and practices emerge almost daily. The framework aims to bring conceptual order to a constantly shifting landscape.

evidence.claim: AI is disrupting software development at a pace where new models, tools, and practices appear almost daily.
JetBrains has conducted almost two years of AI product and market research.

title.es: GM recupera Apple CarPlay para sus pickups 2027 tras críticas
title.en: GM revives Apple CarPlay for its 2027 pickups after backlash

body.es: General Motors da marcha atrás y mostrará una interfaz de infoentretenimiento rediseñada para el Chevrolet Silverado y GMC Sierra 2027 que combina CarPlay con los controles nativos del vehículo en la misma pantalla, con lanzamiento previsto para más adelante este año. El cambio llega tras las críticas generalizadas por retirar CarPlay y Android Auto de sus eléctricos basados en Ultium desde el Chevrolet Blazer EV 2024.
body.en: General Motors is reversing course, showing a redesigned infotainment interface for the 2027 Chevrolet Silverado and GMC Sierra that blends CarPlay with the truck's native controls on the same screen, with rollout planned later this year. The move follows widespread criticism for removing CarPlay and Android Auto from its Ultium-based EVs starting with the 2024 Chevrolet Blazer EV.

evidence.claim: General Motors is reviving Apple CarPlay for its 2027 Chevrolet Silverado and GMC Sierra pickups.
The new system will roll out later this year.
GM faced widespread criticism for removing Apple CarPlay and Android Auto from its Ultium-based electric vehicles starting with the 2024 Chevrolet Blazer EV.
Tesla's own system is preferred by many Tesla owners.

title.es: Un Apple Pencil más corto para el iPhone Duo fue cancelado
title.en: A shorter Apple Pencil for the iPhone Duo was scrapped

text.es: Según Mark Gurman de Bloomberg, Apple estaba desarrollando un Apple Pencil más corto pensado para el iPhone Duo, pero lo canceló por 'problemas técnicos antes de la producción en masa'.
text.en: According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple was developing a shorter Apple Pencil intended for the iPhone Duo, but scrapped it due to 'technical problems ahead of mass production.'

evidence.claim: A shorter Apple Pencil for the iPhone Duo was in development but was scrapped due to technical problems.

title.es: La app Muse de Meta preocupa por su recolección de datos
title.en: Meta's Muse app raises data collection concerns

text.es: La app Muse continúa la tendencia de Meta de suscribir a los usuarios por defecto a la recolección de datos para entrenar IA, y además incita a compartir información de cuenta bancaria, correo electrónico y pasaporte.
text.en: The Muse app continues Meta's trend of opting users into data collection for AI training, and it also nudges users to share bank account, email and passport information.

evidence.claim: The Muse app continues Meta’s trend of opting users into data collection for AI training.
It also nudges you to share your bank account, email, and passport information.

title.es: ¿Está la industria de la IA realmente dispuesta a frenar?
title.en: Is the AI industry really ready to slow down?

text.es: En el podcast Equity se debatió si los ejecutivos de IA realmente son serios cuando dicen querer frenar el ritmo de desarrollo del sector.
text.en: On the Equity podcast, the debate centered on whether AI executives are genuinely serious about wanting to slow the industry's pace.

evidence.claim: On Equity, the debate was about whether AI executives are serious about wanting to slow down.

text.en: Reviewer Marques Brownlee published his review of the iPhone 18 Pro, focused on the device's new chip.
